business_problem: IWill Therapy and IWill CARE, a leading online mental health care provider in India, needed to reach more clients.
solution_summary: IWill Therapy and IWill CARE built its Microsoft solution to improve customer-service and conversational-support workflows. IWill Therapy and IWill CARE, a leading online mental health care provider in India, needed to reach more clients. Key components included Azure OpenAI Service ran model inference or heavy processing, and Azure AI Studio coordinated workflows, prompts, or deployment. User prompts and domain content are orchestrated through Azure AI Studio, processed by Azure OpenAI Service, and then delivered through Azure Kubernetes Service so IWill Therapy and IWill CARE can return context-aware answers or automation in the flow of work. The stack stayed governed and extensible on Microsoft. IWill's scalable, AI-powered bot now provides cognitive behavioral therapy to bring mental health access and therapist-like conversations to people throughout India.

solution_components.name: Azure OpenAI Service
solution_components.role: Runs large language models that generate grounded responses, summaries, and copilots.

solution_components.name: Azure AI Studio
solution_components.role: Provides the build environment for prompt orchestration, safety controls, and model tuning.

solution_components.name: Azure AI Content Safety
solution_components.role: Applies safeguards and filtering to reduce harmful or unsafe AI outputs.

solution_components.name: Azure Kubernetes Service
solution_components.role: Operates containerized application and AI workloads in a managed Kubernetes environment.

solution_components.name: Azure DevOps
solution_components.role: Supports deployment, testing, and release management for the Microsoft solution estate.

solution_components.name: Azure Virtual Machines
solution_components.role: Hosts application workloads and supporting services on Azure infrastructure.
